description: Human-visible RedCap status updates and Feishu notifications must expose the same compact state surface instead of leaking noisy internal audit logs.
status_update_rule: Terminal interruptions and checkpoints must expose the full required_status_fields surface. Feishu node-report messages should expose the compact required_feishu_fields surface so they stay readable on mobile while still showing the human-readable whole-task position.
narrative_quality_rule: Human-facing reports must be paragraph-readable and conclusion-first. Prefer explaining the problem being solved, the chosen solution, the resulting effect, the next step, and whether human help is needed; do not make the primary explanation a changelog of files, scripts, moves, or command outputs.
report_led_summary_rule: When a task report exists, interruption/final updates must summarize report sections 0.1-0.4 first, include 0.5 human-intervention status when available, then surface any non-empty 人工审核要点 or 人工验证项 before technical file/script details.
feishu_alignment_rule: Feishu node-report and manual-intervention messages must use the compact required_feishu_fields surface, not the full terminal status field list. The node-report body must lead with user-visible outcomes and a parent-line whole-task panorama rather than control-plane stages, gates, scripts, file operations, or a narrow current-child route.
feishu_deduplication_rule: Feishu node-report must include exactly one human-readable 整体任务全景图 section. When the parent task ledger is available, that section must come from the parent-line panorama and cover the long-running main task, inserted follow-up tasks, current parent position, remaining blockers, and next step; it must not repeat route content as separate 任务全景图 / 当前位置 / 整体计划脉络图与当前位置 sections and must not use workflow-flavored primary sections such as 任务位置 / 阻塞状态 / 关键证据. Keep traceability under a short 查看记录 section instead of a long 提交清单.
feishu_reply_command_boundary_rule: Today, notify node-report is outbound-only: ordinary replies may be collected by pending-scan on a later session, while ask/confirm/resume can wait for replies during an explicit manual-intervention window. A future real-time Feishu command channel must ingest replies into a RedCap inbox and still pass change-intake, task ledger, manual-decision, and closeout gates before execution.
internal_audit_gap_rule: SessionEnd / Stop audit gaps are internal control-plane signals by default. They must be recorded to pending closure / ledger / diagnostics, but must not send Feishu unless the gap is a true manual-intervention blocker.
